acceptanceObjective: Migrate the Live2D drag-response writer into the global single-lease boundary while preserving the two-stage physics-before input and physics-after visual response, normal release, focus-loss cancellation, and renderer/application recovery.
constraints: Keep one global active input lease; do not add resource-level parallelism or preemption.
The renderer owns drag-response lease lifecycle; DragHandler remains responsible for pointer capture, position, velocity sampling, throw, and focus-loss cancellation.
Preserve physics-before-Cubism-Physics input writes and physics-after visual struggle/final parameter writes.
Normal mouse release, simulated release, focus loss, renderer disable, application quit, destruction, and SafeRecovery must clear drag ownership and leave no stale lease.
Do not expose raw Live2D Param* values or a new LLM/tool entry point; final parameter submission continues through ParameterCommitBridge.
notes: Follow-up design package only. Do not implement drag-response lease integration as part of the walking lease task. Use isolated FU_XUAN_DATA/.test_mode and existing @@sim drag commands; do not use real mouse automation.
